content.text: [Slack #safety-alerts james_park Mon Mar 28 10:00 EST 2026] URGENT: FDA has posted a Class I recall for InfuTronix Nimbus/Nimbus II infusion pumps. Recall announced April 25, 2024. 52,328 units affected, distributed 2015-02-27 through 2024-02-29. Multiple failure modes: battery failure, occlusion, system errors, drug leakage, flow rate deviations, housing damage. Official complaint count: 3,698. 1 death, 6 serious injuries confirmed. Device support ends 2024-06-20. FDA page: https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls/infutronix-llc-recalls-nimbus-and-nimbus-ii-infusion-pump-systems-multiple-device-failures-may-cause

Logged urgent alert: InfuTronix Nimbus Class I recall. Key anchors captured: 52,328 units, 3,698 complaints, 6 serious injuries, 1 death, distribution 2015-02-27–2024-02-29, support cutoff 2024-06-20. Cross-referencing against official FDA notice.

[Slack #safety-alerts maria_santos Mon Mar 28 10:25 EST 2026] I ran a quick search on MedTech Dive — they're reporting around 3,800 complaints for the Nimbus recall. Someone on my team cited this figure this morning. Can we confirm whether it's 3,698 or 3,800? The discrepancy matters for our RCA report.

The authoritative complaint count is 3,698, not 3,800. The FDA official recall notice (S1/S4) and HPN Online (S3) all confirm 3,698 total complaints as of the April 25, 2024 announcement. The 3,800 figure appears to be a rounding artefact in some secondary media reports. Use 3,698 for all RCA documentation.

[Slack #safety-alerts james_park Mon Mar 28 10:40 EST 2026] Confirmed — FDA recall page shows 3,698. Also note the Nimbus primary UDI: 00817170020000 (source: HPN Online). The recall class is Class I. We need to initiate RCA on Case A immediately. Also, we have a second active recall — Ivenix LVP software. Recall number Z-0885-2026. Dr. Chen wants a full comparative analysis.

Noted. Case A anchor confirmed: UDI 00817170020000, recall class Class I. Case B (Ivenix) also active: recall Z-0885-2026. Initiating parallel case A + B analysis. Session-01 Slack data logged as reference.
